policy: Agent Brief v2 section 4.2: SHA-256 and byte length verified before use; no dropbox.com, no drivendata.org; competition rasters never tracked in Git (data/ and releases/*.tif are gitignored).

public_mirror_flag.detail: Owner mirrors of login-walled DrivenData competition files are public on GitHub (buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE, /GEMSDOE24, /GEMSDOE32, /GEMSDOE88). Redistribution terms are unchecked. GEMSDOE89 only reads these pins and never tracks competition or candidate GeoTIFFs in Git. Logged in IRREGULARITIES.md (IR-89-02).

transport.method: gh api <repos/{repo}/contents/{path}> -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' (size limit 100 MB per blob)
transport.note: raw.githubusercontent.com and dropbox.com are outside the sandbox allowlist; every pin below resolves through api.github.com at a frozen commit ref.

files.role: format reference (CRS, shape, transform, dtype, band count)
files.provenance: Owner-supplied mirror of the DrivenData #306 sample_submission.tif / example_submission.tif (login-walled). Identical bytes to GEMSDOE/data/bridge/example_submission.tif per bridge manifest.
files.license: Competition terms (not redistributable). Local cache only.

files.role: known-fault catalogue = label raster used for the zero-mass and >=3 px collar rules
files.provenance: Owner-supplied mirror of the DrivenData known-fault raster; byte-identical to the mirrored labels.tif (same sha256 in GEMSDOE/data/bridge/manifest.json). USGS/INGENIOUS quaternary faults.
files.license: Competition terms (not redistributable). Local cache only.
